installer-gui-script.title: JARVIS

choice.title: Python (latest stable) — required
choice.description: Installs the latest Python from python.org into /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/. Required to run JARVIS. Automatically skipped if Python 3.11 or newer is already installed.

choice.title: 3B — Efficient · 8 GB RAM · bundled, no download
choice.description: qwen2.5:3b — Fast, capable everyday assistant. Bundled inside this installer so no internet is needed. Best for MacBooks and Macs with 8 GB RAM.

choice.title: 7B — Balanced · 16 GB RAM · ~4.5 GB download
choice.description: qwen2.5:7b — A big step up in reasoning and language quality. Great for most tasks. Recommended for 16 GB RAM Macs.

choice.title: 14B — High quality · 32 GB RAM · ~9 GB download
choice.description: qwen2.5:14b — Excellent reasoning, coding, and conversation quality. Runs well on 32 GB M-series Macs.

choice.title: 32B — Best quality · 64 GB RAM · ~20 GB download
choice.description: qwen2.5:32b — Near GPT-4-class quality, fully private and offline. Requires a Mac with 64 GB unified memory (M2/M3 Max or Ultra).

choice.title: 72B — Maximum quality · 128 GB RAM · ~45 GB download
choice.description: qwen2.5:72b — State-of-the-art local LLM performance. Requires 128 GB unified memory (Mac Studio / Mac Pro with M2/M3 Ultra).
